# international-patient-summary-service-with-axum

> Backend for the IPS viewer: stores HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary document Bundles in Postgres and serves them as application/fhir+json. Every /fhir route needs a Keycloak or PASETO bearer token, under one role policy, and every access is logged.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): quick start, container image, API, layout
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): rules
- [Specification](spec/index.md): single source of truth; §4 is the API
- [Plan](plans.md): phases 1-5
- [Tasks](tasks.md): checklist
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Commands

- serve: `cargo run -- start`
- check: `cargo run -- check`
- migrate: `cargo run -- db migrate`
- status: `cargo run -- db status`
- test: `cargo test`
- test-all: `AXA_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://... cargo test -- --include-ignored`
- lint: `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- image: `podman compose --profile image up -d --build`

## API

- [POST /fhir/Bundle](src/routes.rs): store an IPS document: 201 + Location, or 422 problem with code and pointer
- [GET /fhir/Bundle/{id}](src/routes.rs): the stored Bundle, Cache-Control: no-store, or 404
- [DELETE /fhir/Bundle/{id}](src/routes.rs): 204 or 404
- [Health](src/lib.rs): /_health/live, /_health/ready (waits on migrations and Keycloak's keys), /_health/startup; no token needed
- Every /fhir route: 401 without a valid bearer token, 403 when the policy refuses; access logged in ips_access_log

## Modules

- [main](src/main.rs): command line: start, db, check
- [lib](src/lib.rs): defaults, routes, context, the app behind its guard
- [auth](src/auth.rs): Keycloak and PASETO guards, the production refusal; [policy](src/policy.json): access by role
- [ips](src/ips.rs): structural IPS check and refusal codes
- [store](src/store.rs): SQL
- [migrations](migrations/): sqlx reversible migrations
- [Containerfile](Containerfile): the distroless image; `compose.yml` profile `image` runs it with Postgres
- [tests](tests/api.rs): request tests; [auth tests](tests/auth.rs): tokens, policy, access log; fixtures in tests/fixtures/
- [realm](keycloak/ips-realm.json): the development Keycloak realm (`compose.yml --profile keycloak`)
